description: Individually reviewed, time-boxed acceptance of known advisories. Anything not listed here fails the CI audit gate (scripts/check_audit_allowlist.py).

accepted.rationale: All advisories are fixed only in Pillow 13.0.0, which gradio 6.30.0 forbids (pillow<13). No image-decoding code path is reachable in this application; compensating controls are enforced by tests. Re-review when a Gradio release permits Pillow 13. Re-reviewed 2026-10-28: the advisory database re-keyed two reviewed advisories under PYSEC ids (PYSEC-2026-4326 = GHSA-27h8-gf7j-v5hc, PYSEC-2026-4328 = GHSA-4rr5-89j8-mwwm) and added PYSEC-2026-4327 (CVE-2026-112394, raw P;2L/P;4L decoder over-read, fixed in 13.0.0, decoder not reachable here). CVE-2026-112403 / GHSA-8g5g-8vmr-9782 (JPEG decode heap overflow, fixed in 13.0.0) is reported by Trivy but not by pip-audit; same disposition.
